nodes.text: You're the one Mr. Sato sent? Good. I'll be plain: 302 is not... settling. I don't want police, I don't want a priest making a scene. I want it quiet again.

options.text: Give me the key and I'll look.
Give me the key and I'll look.

nodes.text: A chair, dragging. Water running all night. And — once — his voice, through the door, saying he'd be late for work. He hasn't had work in nine days.
Quiet man. Paid on time. The mail's still coming for him — it's piling up in the basement. I couldn't bring myself to throw it out.
I don't know you well enough to hand you a key to my building. Show me you know what you're doing first.
...All right. Here. Top lock sticks. And — whatever's in there — don't make it worse.
